description: This file defines a Python class 'LocalCoreMLSmartTurnAnalyzer' that performs on-device end-of-turn detection using CoreML models, specifically optimized for Apple hardware. It loads a CoreML model and feature extractor, and provides a method for predicting turn completion probability from audio data.

classes.name: LocalCoreMLSmartTurnAnalyzer
classes.description: A class that performs local, on-device end-of-turn detection using CoreML models, with methods for initializing and predicting turn completion from audio input.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the analyzer by loading the CoreML model and feature extractor from the specified path.

methods.name: _predict_endpoint
methods.description: Performs prediction of turn completion probability from an audio array using the loaded CoreML model.
